# Samuel Burke

> Independent software developer and founder of Burke Systems, a small software studio in Raleigh-Durham, NC. Builds products end to end, from design to deployment.

## Work

- [ShiftView](https://shiftview.app): Scheduling and a time clock for retail and fulfillment teams. Built solo to solve the scheduling and timekeeping problems Samuel faced as a retail manager, with Next.js 16, React 19, Supabase and TypeScript. Deterministic auto-scheduler, real-time coverage, two-layer security (API route handlers plus row-level security), 1,600+ automated tests. Source: https://github.com/samuel-burke/shiftview. Case study (architecture, auth and security, CI/CD): https://samuelburke.dev/work/shiftview/
- Study Squad (in development): A group study timer for Root communities: a shared pomodoro timer, a live board of who is focusing on what, and a light game layer (XP, streaks, a weekly community boss). Built solo with TypeScript, React, the Root SDK and SQLite. The server stores only when a cycle started, so every client derives the same countdown; all rules live in a pure TypeScript engine shared by the server and an in-browser demo. Source: https://github.com/samuel-burke/study-squad-root-app. Case study: https://samuelburke.dev/work/study-squad/

## Background

- Founder, Burke Systems (fall 2026–now)
- Fulfillment Department Supervisor, Lowe’s, Wake Forest NC (summer 2024–now; supervisor since Oct 2025; joined Aug 2024 as a loader, then sales associate and Pro Services sales specialist): manages the district's largest fulfillment team; the scheduling and timekeeping problems ShiftView solves
- B.S. Computer Science, NC State University (fall 2024)
- QA engineering intern, ZenGRC (summer 2022): wrote end-to-end tests for the QA team
